If an AI agent wrote or submitted this pull request, start with a note saying which agent, for whom,
and whether a person reviewed it, for example:

> [!NOTE]
> Written and submitted by <model> via <harness> for <person>, who has not reviewed it.
-->

## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe what happens before and after this change and link the issue.

## Decisions and limits

Explain the choices that matter to users and reviewers, why they were made, and remaining limits.

## Verification

For a release or substantial UI/workflow change, assess the human-testing gate
in RELEASING.md. Link the assigned test request and pending stable-release
blockers, or the completed human report and why it still covers this candidate.
State what changed since the tested build and how relevant open defects were
resolved or accepted. Candidate publication and this PR's merge must not close
an unanswered human request; link it in the handoff as well.

List commands, additional inputs, platforms, LibreOffice versions, results, and CI run links. Say
which deliberately broken behaviour was shown to fail its check, where that was practical.
Maintainers add the review choice: author review only, or the independent reviewer, the reviewed
commit, and the outcome of each round.
